feature: Portal: customer-facing ticket submission + in-portal thread view via Zoho Desk (#1045). #3998 (Feature #1659) wired the real page — artifacts/portal/src/pages/customer-requests.tsx, route /requests — against these same four routes, against the real design at Design/portal/design_handoff_full_site/screens/Requests and Support Chat.dc.html.
notes: Covers the four new customer-scoped routes in portal-customer-requests.ts (mounted in routes/index.ts): POST /api/portal/customer/requests (open a request -> enqueueEscalationTicket, same Zoho Desk write path as ShaneBot's escalation), GET /api/portal/customer/requests (list the caller's own tickets), GET /api/portal/customer/requests/:ticketId (detail + conversation thread, ownership-enforced), POST /api/portal/customer/requests/:ticketId/reply (public comment, ownership-enforced).

WHAT THESE apiTests ASSERT: every route is registered and gated by requireCapability('ladder.customer-user'). Called with NO auth token, each must answer 401 (not 404) - 404 would mean the route isn't mounted, 200 would mean the auth gate is missing. This is the deploy-independent, credential-independent contract worth locking in a regression suite.

HONEST LIMIT (deploy): shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, so until this branch is deployed these routes 404 rather than 401, and the new /requests page/route 404s too. A red run here immediately after this commit, before Shane deploys, is expected and is NOT a manifest regression - re-run once deployed.

HONEST LIMIT (full happy path): exercising create/list/thread/reply end-to-end needs (a) a credentialed Customer session - the HTTP apiTests executor cannot mint one, same gap money-path-e2e.json documents - and (b) a live Zoho Desk connection with a configured Department. zoho-desk.ts's own header notes Zoho Desk endpoints are not live-verified in this environment (no credentials / no Department). So contact-resolution, ticket listing, conversation fetch, and reply posting cannot be asserted against real Zoho data from here; all three read/reply routes are written to degrade to a structured 200 { configured:false, ... } shape when Zoho isn't connected rather than error (Git #2512 - detail and reply used to return a bare 503 for this identical condition; aligned to match list's contract, commit ac7b38446, confirmed still true against the route file as of this session's own commit).

HONEST LIMIT (async): a freshly-submitted request is created by the Zoho batch drain (~every 5 min), not synchronously in the POST response (which returns 202 queued), so even with full credentials a create would not appear in the immediately-following list call - the UI copy says so.

OWNERSHIP: getDeskTicketForContact compares the ticket's contactId to the caller's own resolved contactId; foreign or unknown ids both 404 so a customer can't probe another customer's ticket by id. Not assertable here without two credentialed customers + live Zoho, documented as the security-relevant behavior to re-verify when those are available.

#3998 (sessionTag 3998) UI STEPS: deliberately do NOT click 'Open a request' — that button only renders when the list read comes back configured:true (see customer-requests.tsx), and per the HONEST LIMIT above this environment's TEST_CUSTOMER account has no live Zoho Department, so whether that button is even present today is genuinely unknown from here; asserting a click against it would be a coin-flip-red step, not a real regression signal. What IS asserted regardless of that state: the page itself renders, the live/loading/failed status line renders, and the two reciprocal ShaneBot<->Requests links (unconditional in both pages' markup, not gated behind configured) are both present.
